relationship: Read-only interpretation of owned baseline symbols, interface/type declarations and kernel data; no proprietary BIOS implementation inspection. Headers and kernel image are hashed, not copied.

layout_basis.HANDLE_TABLE: TableCode at 0; level-zero entries 8 bytes; handle index handle>>2.
layout_basis.OBJECT_HEADER: Body at 24, Type at 8, NameInfoOffset at 12; name info Unicode string at 4.
layout_basis.FILE_OBJECT_SARCH_XBOX: DeviceObject at 4, Vpb at 0x4c, FileName at 0x60. PublishedFlags byte at 3 and native Flags ULONG at 0x5c.
layout_basis.DEVICE_OBJECT_SARCH_XBOX: DriverObject at 8, DeviceExtension at 0x18, DeviceType byte at 0x1c, SectorSize at 0x20.
layout_basis.VFAT_DEVICE_EXTENSION: 32-bit ERESOURCE size 0x38 twice; lock/list/hash fields put VolumeDevice at 0x84, StorageDevice at 0x88, FATINFO at 0x90. Both pointers independently match VPB links. FATINFO BytesPerSector +0x30, FatType +0x3c; extension Flags +0xe8.
layout_basis.constants: Device types 7 disk, 8 disk filesystem; FATX16=4; VCB_IS_FATX=4 and VCB_GOOD=0x10. Native file flags: SYNCHRONOUS_IO=2, ALERTABLE_IO=4, NO_INTERMEDIATE_BUFFERING=8. Published file flags: synchronous=1, alertable=2, no-intermediate-buffering=4, opened=0x20.

snapshot_lineage: Coordinating agent identifies the memory capture with the preserved Spirit missing-world scene. Preserved qcow2 identity is separately recorded; the offline reader binds to the RAM hash directly.

complex_v5.scope: Full log field-availability audit only, not timing or replay statistics.
